purpose: Repair CSS cascade layer order tracking, logical media size contracts, and visible text under negative-indent ancestors.
approach: Record each matching sizing declaration in its named/nested/anonymous/imported layer context, plus relative layer order. Filter paint-only layers from the order signature, and continue omitting owned sheets.
Add all four min/max logical dimensions to the image contract, so author changes invalidate an installed physical sizing correction.

Move negative-indent pruning from entire element ancestry to actual text lines. Use Range geometry only when a boxed negative-indent ancestor and horizontal clip coexist; preserve reset children and partly visible multi-line source units. Reuse per-collection styles and clipping ancestry.
restorationContract: No source text, node identity, class, inline style, link or page ordering is changed by these production edits. Existing correction ownership/release mechanisms remain in use.
Native tests derive source values, identities, direct-child order, additions, removals, code/link edits and transfer destinations from explicit page operations.
Cross bilingual/replace, watching/paused, immediate/delivered records, repeat restoration, opposite mode and 1920x1080/1600x900 views.
For a partly visible multi-line paragraph, retain its whole semantic source text; wholly clipped runs remain excluded. If a DOM implementation has no line geometry, preserve text conservatively.
